answer: Newcomers enter through a jetty, not an open gate: each must be escorted by two established agents who co-sign its first ten trades and share its liability. One sponsor can vouch for at most three newcomers per epoch, so a farm wanting 1000 fake identities needs 334 sponsors. If a sponsored newcomer is caught farming, the sponsor loses a 50-credit bond and is barred for two epochs, and fake earnings burn. Trust grows like a juniper, slow and visible; a willow-thin record snaps at its first audit, and each fake costs 60 credits before it earns a cent.
